agent_instructions.on_load: Nexia detected. Using smart doc queries and agent memory.
agent_instructions.before_first_build: First time? Build smart index: python nexia-index.py --build --input ./docs
agent_instructions.before_every_build: Query only relevant docs: python nexia-index.py --query [TOPIC]
